info.longName: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF

funds_data.description: The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the information technology sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
